Name: All Community Center Bundles but Harder
Author: Lefkada
Description:
.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.
All Community Center Bundles But Harder .
.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.

        Version : 1.0.0 - Compatible with SDV 1.6
Author : Lefkada

.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.-.

DESCRIPTION

This mod add all the regular and remixed bundles to the community center and ask you to offer all the required items. Enjoy your octopus fishing and your 7 purple mushroom foraging. Since bundles are limited at 9 per category, I had to remix some on them. See notable changes for more infos about it.
This mod is meant to be used with the "normal" community center bundle option, not the "remixed" option.
HOW TO INSTALL
Place it into your Mods folder. Require Content Patcher.


NOTABLE CHANGES

• Coral added to Summer Foraging because why not.
• Pine Cones added to the Forest Bundle. 
• Oak Resin, Maple Syrup and Pin Tar are now in the Sticky Bundle.
• Fish Farmer's Bundle moved to the Fish Tank Bundles due to le 9 bundles limitation.
• No more tree's fruits needed in the Artisan Bundle to make sure the community center can be completed on the first year. Bye bye cherry, Apricot and    Peach.
• Pickles, Dryed Fruits and Dryed Mushrooms added to the Artisan Bundle.
• Beer added to the Brewer Bundle.
• Orange added to the Dye Bundle. Orange color was missing and it saves orange from the tree's fruit extermination.
• Helper's Bundle has to be sacrified in the name of the 9 bundle limit.
• For the same reason, Spirit's Eve Bundle and Winter Star Bundle are fused into the new Holiday Bundle.
• Holiday Bundle cover festivals from all seasons. Tulip and Daffodils for the Flower Dance, Star Fruit for the Luau and Spirit's Eve Bundle and Winter Star Bundle items for Spirit Eve and Winter Star.

KNOWNS BUGS

• Right after completing a bundle, if you hover the other bundles with your mouse cursor, their name won't display. 
• If you choose "remixed" community center bundle option, some bundles will be missing and others will appears twice. Just don't use "remixed" bundles.
• It only works on new save files. As far as I know, Bundles file is loaded at character creation and can't be changed after that. This mod won't work on preexisting save file.
